description_en: Attaches an existing security group to a Network Load Balancing (NLB) instance
description_zh: 为网络型负载均衡实例绑定已创建的安全组
name: LoadBalancerJoinSecurityGroup

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the security groups
parameters.name: security_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Network Load Balancing (NLB) instance to which you want to attach the security group
parameters.help_zh: 待绑定安全组的网络型负载均衡实例ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: The system checks the request but does not associate the security group with the instance. The system checks items such as whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the check, the system returns an error. If the request passes the check, the system returns the error code DryRunOperation.
false (default): The system sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancing (NLB) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The result of associating an existing security group with an NLB instance
schema.description_zh: 为NLB实例绑定已创建的安全组

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
